name: @dsh-external/dsh-auto-advance
description: Auto-advancer for the pentest / code-audit presets: when a subagent-class executor returns and the intent ledger still has open directions, a followup nudge is injected carrying the ledger state — close the intent (done with output pointer / blocked with reason), then anchor-dispatch the next step or finish quietly. Guardrailed autonomy: consecutive-turn cap (human input resets), opt-in via the intent ledger (open intents required), self-describing nudges, and a cooldown window that coalesces parallel returns. Injects only — never intercepts or rewrites; non-security or ledger-less sessions are untouched. Kickoff nudge: the first human message in a security-mode session with no operation-state draws a one-time three-registration reminder (goal/constraints/scope) — no hard gate, quick tasks may ignore. Mode-aware kickoff: the first-registration reminder carries the session mode's decomposition theory, criteria structure, scope semantics and constraint hints (DECOMPOSITION imported from the sibling stage-gate plugin with generic-text degrade).
author: Saker contributors
